Featuring 80 PLUS® BRONZE certification, a quiet 120mm fan, CSK Bronze includes Antec’s 3-year warranty. The CircuitShield™ suite of industrial-grade protections ensure that the power delivered to your system is safe and reliable in any environment.
Better Looking Builds
The semi-modular cabling system lets you use the cables you need, allowing your build to save space and reduce clutter, and improving the airflow.
